name: ECSSD: Extended Complex Scene Saliency Dataset
description: ECSSD is a computer vision benchmark for salient object detection and foreground segmentation. It comprises 1,000 structurally complex natural images gathered from the Internet with manually annotated ground-truth pixel-level binary saliency masks provided by five independent annotators.
